final_text: Campaign complete. For the single spec **bursty_offload**, I ran the full 400-evaluation L1 DSE graph (24-design feasible Pareto front, all pipelined_m), then L2 SimPy simulation of the top 5 — all passed the p99 latency constraint (simulated 0.107–0.145 µs vs the 0.4 µs limit), with the winner unchanged. L3/L4/L5 found no recorded verification or synthesis measurements for the selected design, so back_annotate had nothing to compare and flagged no winner change (no reexplore needed). Finalized selection: `pipelined_m:data_width=15, n_iter=12, angle_guard=1, frac_guard=2, rounding=trunc, m=4` — 853 LUT+FF (654 LUT / 199 FF), 10.3 accuracy bits (max error 2^-10.34, within the 2^-10 limit), 97.8 Msps throughput, and simulated p99 latency 0.135 µs.
